message.Title: Generally Available: DocumentDB extension for VS Code

Body.Content:
DocumentDB for VS Code is now generally available. This free, open-source extension brings Azure DocumentDB and the open-source DocumentDB project into Visual Studio Code, supporting any MongoDB API-compatible workload. 

You can connect to Azure DocumentDB clusters, Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB accounts, Kubernetes-hosted databases, MongoDB Atlas, or self-hosted servers. Authentication supports Microsoft Entra ID and managed identity. 

The extension includes a built-in Interactive shell that reuses existing connections, so there is no separate shell to install or configure. You can browse collections; query data in table, tree, or JSON views; use schema-aware autocompletion; and save repeatable scripts in a Query Playground. 

It also supports DocumentDB Local with Docker and sample data, Query Insights for execution plans and statistics, optional GitHub Copilot recommendations, index management, cluster dashboards, and copy-paste migration of collections and indexes between databases or clusters. 

Install it from the Visual Studio Marketplace. 

Learn more.
